property_summary: For any caller and any _unlockTime, after Put(_unlockTime) the stored unlock time equals max(_unlockTime, block.timestamp) (a past timestamp cannot shorten the lock); the mutant stores _unlockTime verbatim, so a past _unlockTime yields a lock time already elapsed, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Replace the ternary unlockTime assignment with a direct assignment so the caller can set an unlockTime in the past, allowing immediate Collect.
